source.text:
Location: Bengaluru, India (IST / UTC+5:30)

Remote: Yes — remote only (worked remotely 2.5+ years)

Willing to relocate: No

Engagement: Contract / freelance, ~20 hrs/week. Not looking for full-time.

Technologies: TypeScript/Node, Next.js, React, React Native/Expo, Hono, Cloudflare Workers/D1, AWS (Lambda/ECS/Fargate), PostgreSQL, Redis, Swift/SwiftUI, LLM systems (OpenAI/Gemini/Groq, RAG, multi-agent)

Résumé: https://anuragsoni.com (portfolio + work history)

GitHub: https://github.com/amaze-28

Email: anuunity28@gmail.com

I ship complete products solo.

https://anuragsoni.com/shotspa?ref=hn — Mac app that polishes screenshots automatically the moment you take one without changing your workflow, launched recently, built end to end in Swift/SwiftUI including the whole Apple distribution pipeline.

https://commitposts.com — AI turns merged PRs into a changelog page, emails and an in-app widget. I built it so the customers actually get to know what's being shipped.

https://clubmint.app — memberships, renewals and revenue tracking for gym and studio owners.

Previously worked as Backend/full-stack engineer at an edtech serving 15M students. Built the OCR pipeline processing 10M answer sheets bi-monthly (the company's core revenue product), data pipelines at 100–200K records/day, and LLM/RAG systems in production.

Recently resigned from my full-time SWE job to work on my own ideas and take freelance/contract work on the side.
